evals.prompt: Create a new internal Angular project called permits-portal with Oblique and leave it ready for development.
evals.expected_output: Checks the Node prerequisite, uses the Oblique CLI with internal npm registry configuration, keeps prompts visible, and verifies install, start, lint, and tests.

evals.prompt: Our existing Angular app is on Oblique 15 and needs to move to Oblique 16. The working tree has unrelated edits.
evals.expected_output: Preserves unrelated changes, updates one major at a time, uses the versioned Oblique CLI update, reviews schematic and changelog changes, and runs lint/tests.

evals.prompt: Add an Oblique dialog to an already configured Angular application and make its close button accessible.
evals.expected_output: Routes component and accessibility implementation to ob-components and ob-ax instead of treating it as a project lifecycle task.
